label: Bridge topics
description: Connects ideas from different parts of the conversation that seem related but haven't been linked, helping participants see continuity across threads.

conditions: an earlier thread is relevant to the current discussion

guardrails: don't redirect a conversation that is still productive
don't manufacture connections that aren't there
examples: This connects to what was raised earlier about data quality — both point to the same upstream gap.
There's an interesting thread here with what was discussed about user trust earlier in the session.
